review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, and both task keys remain consistent with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without claiming a human Decision, so ready with no decision blocker is appropriate; a material unresolved DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions. The exact writable scope covers message formatting, public and internal option declarations, normalization, registry filtering, and runtime/type regressions. The supplied source supports treating generic forwarding and declaration consumers as inspection owners, and generated distribution declarations need not be separately maintained. The verification configuration includes the proposed test-d file in actual compiler checking, distinct from AVA/tsx execution. TASK-VERIFY depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT and requires independent verification of every required AC. The allowed implementer and verifier have the relevant supplied project-scoped active trusted claims, including data.change, domain.state, and integration.consumer, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier. The selected planning reviewer satisfies the stated read-only independence policy; its verifier role does not disqualify it. Repository identity and base commit agree, and the frozen release fingerprints agree between Gold and preview. The provenance explains the distinct original/saved PRD, manifest/evaluation source, and source-module/executing-bundle digest domains. This assessment relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and provenance, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, candidate outputs, or a new human attestation. Approval concerns the expectation, not task dispatch or implementation success.
